test_vectors.execution: Not executed, as instructed. No compiler, formatter, build, test, check, or commit command was run.
coverage: Exact import preserves schema name, schema ID, required_count, reject_unknown, field order, full-width field IDs, required flags, scalar tags, supplied formats, and every numeric constraint.
Import transfers the original owned IR allocations and forwards the exact borrowed input pointer, all bytes, and the complete Limits value to the application codec.
Export supplies a separately owned exact LegacySchema with its description, preserves opaque NUL and non-UTF-8 output bytes, and does not apply JSON payload limits to schema artifacts.

Nonempty descriptions, including whitespace-only and Unicode descriptions, fail under Reject and produce exactly the contracted description warning under AllowDocumented; Conversion::map retains the warning.

Versions 0, 2, 255, and 65535 fail under both loss policies across all adapters; invalid option versions prevent codec invocation, and invalid codec/document wrapper versions cannot override valid options.
Empty schema and field names fail with MissingRequiredField; whitespace and exact case are preserved without trimming or normalization.
Nonadjacent duplicate FieldIds and field names fail with DuplicateObjectKey, including permissive duplicate-key settings and both loss policies.

Incorrect required_count values are rejected without repair; empty schemas accept zero required fields; 65535 required fields succeed and 65536 fail through checked counting. Total optional fields can exceed the u16 required-count range.
Inverted length and integer bounds and empty supplied format names fail with ConstraintViolation and schema/field context.
Inclusive equal bounds, absent bounds, lower-only and upper-only bounds, zero, u32::MAX, i64::MIN, and i64::MAX remain exact through import and export.
All five ScalarKind variants and None, absent formats, custom Unicode format names, and nonempty whitespace formats are preserved without synthesizing or interpreting constraints.
Schema input ceilings 0, 1, and 4 accept their exact boundary and reject one byte more before decoding; max_output_bytes does not constrain schema import.

Codec UnsupportedSchemaFeature, InvalidUtf8, TrailingContent, DepthLimitExceeded, DecodedArenaOverflow, BudgetExhausted, and Cancelled errors retain canonical codes, offsets, IDs, and static details while using SchemaCompile source.
Opaque schema output accepts exact and zero-byte ceilings, rejects excess, and supports a u32::MAX ceiling without eagerly allocating it.

Ignored or replaced sink write/reserve failures remain fatal; checked usize length overflow, subsequent empty operations, reservation length semantics, incremental writes, and unchanged storage after failure are asserted.
Documentation round trips preserve UTF-8 bytes, composed and decomposed Unicode, Markdown punctuation, CRLF and LF, NUL, tabs, spaces, empty bodies, and the imported String owners without warnings.

Documentation title and body share the byte budget: the two-byte title e-acute plus the three-byte body cat ideograph succeeds at five bytes and fails at four, independently testing import payload and output ceilings.

Empty documentation titles fail with MissingRequiredField even at a zero byte ceiling; nonempty titles fail zero ceilings; documentation export is bounded by output size without an input payload ceiling.
Documentation checked arithmetic handles zero, inclusive limits, u32::MAX, usize::MAX additions, and one-past-u32 limits without allocating huge strings.
Deterministic Vec capacity overflow returns BudgetExhausted without changing existing data; schema export/import fixture round trips isolate description loss from exact IR preservation.
limitations: Tests are present but intentionally unexecuted under the task restrictions.

The codec fixture scripts model returns and opaque output, since the frozen API delegates legacy grammar, full-input consumption, UTF-8, nesting, and decoded-memory enforcement to the application codec.
Allocator exhaustion is not induced nondeterministically; allocation error mapping uses fallible reservations and deterministic capacity-overflow coverage.
